subject: ACME Order Form — post-signature handover & custody
messages:
From: Jillian Park <jillian.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Todd Meyer <todd.meyer@acmecloud.com>, legal@acmecloud.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACME Order Form: signature flow questions

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for sending the clean MSA and the order form. A couple quick questions from legal/procurement before we start the DocuSign run:

1) Our procurement team wants the signature flow to land with our CFO (primary) and Head of Procurement (secondary) as signers. Is it possible to set signer order and require both signatures in the DocuSign envelope?

2) Post-sign custody: ACME requires that the fully executed copies be uploaded to our Contracts repository and that the signing manifest (IP/retention statements) be bundled into the final PDF. Do you handle transfer of the signed PDF to a shared Drive folder, or should we pull it from the DocuSign link?

3) Authority confirmation: can you include a short signer authority statement in the signing page (i.e., "I confirm I have authority to bind my company")? Our legal prefers an explicit line.

If you can confirm the flow and who will be the Redwood sender on the envelope, we can queue signatures on our side.

Appreciate it — Jillian

--
Jillian Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
ACME Cloud

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ACME Order Form: signature flow questions

Hi Jillian —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and a proposed plan:

1) Signer order: yes, DocuSign supports serial signing (CFO first, Procurement second). We will set the envelope to enforce recipient routing so the second recipient cannot sign until the first has.

2) Post-sign custody: Redwood will export the final signed PDF and upload to the shared Drive folder you designate. We can also send an archival copy to your legal mailbox (legal@acmecloud.com). Please confirm the folder path (or we can send the DocuSign completed-envelope link and you can pull it).

3) Authority language: we can add a one-line confirmation above each signature block. I attached a proposed clean MSA and a draft order form with the added signer language.

Proposed next steps:
- We (Redwood) will originate the DocuSign envelope and set routing: Evelyn (Redwood sender) -> ACME CFO (signer 1) -> ACME Head of Procurement (signer 2).
- Attach the final MSA + Order Form into the envelope as the documents to be signed.
- After completion, Redwood will upload the executed PDF to ACME's shared Drive folder and email a copy to legal@acmecloud.com.

If that works, please provide the full names/emails for the CFO and Head of Procurement, plus the Drive folder link.

Thanks — Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
